items.capability: Android local inference and benchmark league
items.why: Runtime qualification and data-only validator still assume Linux facilities.
items.userImpact: No Android model recommendation or local inference league result is advertised.
items.workaround: Use the verified deterministic local jobs.
items.closure: A capability adapter, validator tests, approved real inference and independent benchmark evidence.

items.capability: Phone battery, charging, thermal, metering and accelerator telemetry
items.why: Base Termux cannot obtain the required observations; existing phone-local ADB reconnect failed.
items.userImpact: Conservative policy blocks optional model acquisition and benchmarking. GPU/NPU and power remain unknown.
items.workaround: Read available RAM/storage; do not substitute server sensors or infer watts.
items.closure: A read-only phone-local adapter with identity, units, freshness and physical validation.

items.capability: Model resource feasibility on a busy handset
items.why: Available RAM fluctuated below the reserve despite larger installed RAM.
items.userImpact: Some otherwise compatible models cannot be admitted safely.
items.workaround: Continue lightweight local jobs; review capacity before explicitly approving model work.
items.closure: Fresh sufficient available resources and a qualified runtime; total RAM alone is insufficient.

items.capability: Android background reliability and recovery breadth
items.why: Android may reclaim Termux. Reboot, battery shutdown and forced OS reclamation were not exercised.
items.userImpact: No server-grade daemon or automatic reboot recovery claim.
items.workaround: Keep Termux foreground; restart using the documented command and inspect retained state.
items.closure: Device-specific interruption, reboot and resource-pressure evidence without weakening governance.

items.capability: Additional phones and optional PWA launcher
items.why: Physical standalone evidence covers one Pixel and the browser path; PWA installability passed but launcher install was not exercised.
items.userImpact: Other handset and launcher combinations are unqualified.
items.workaround: Use the tested local browser path.
items.closure: Reproducible handset reports and launcher close/reopen tests, with no identifying or credential payloads.

items.why: No already-authorised metered provider was discovered. Included subscription access is non-metered.
items.userImpact: No physical exact-money API comparison.
items.workaround: Show unavailable billing separately from token counts.
items.closure: An authorised billed request with provider usage/price revision and reconciliation evidence.

items.capability: Positive billed cache and delayed billing corrections
items.why: Provider billing evidence is unavailable.
items.userImpact: Cached token semantics are not represented as proven billed savings.
items.workaround: Preserve unavailable cost and the deterministic accounting tests.
items.closure: A provider-supported positive cache charge and delayed adjustment, reconciled to the ledger.

items.why: Shared device load prevents defensible exclusive allocation.
items.userImpact: No Wh/job, tokens/Wh or incremental baseline saving.
items.workaround: Publish coverage-labelled component intervals only.
items.closure: A qualified baseline, matching load boundary and justified allocation, with preserved raw samples.

items.why: No operator tariff evidence was configured.
items.userImpact: No measured local electricity cost.
items.workaround: Keep monetary electricity fields unavailable.
items.closure: A time-effective tariff/currency/unit reference and attributable measured energy.

items.why: No actual W/Wh/kWh sensor with a defensible machine binding was discovered.
items.userImpact: No whole-node or local-versus-cloud energy comparison.
items.workaround: Use explicitly scoped GPU board observations. Never derive watts from UPS load percentage.
items.closure: Read-only measurement integration, units, sample semantics and explicit machine/outlet binding; aggregate UPS load alone is insufficient.

items.why: The integrated pipeline has source and control evidence; fresh exact-plan model execution is separately gated.
items.userImpact: No universal winner, unseen target result or overnight improvement may be inferred.
items.workaround: Review the real source shortlist and the exact execution proposal.
items.closure: Approved acquisition, validated native attempts, personal league ingestion and linked Process/Estate evidence.

items.why: Schedule/deduplication/budget controls are tested; a real overnight-duration run has not been qualified.
items.userImpact: The morning view is a recorded intelligence brief, not proof of unattended overnight success.
items.workaround: Run an explicitly approved manual watch and inspect evidence.
items.closure: An authorised bounded overnight watch with timestamps, interruption/reconciliation and notification evidence.

items.why: No destination is configured; additional feeds need source approval and adapters.
items.userImpact: No external delivery or universal source coverage claim.
items.workaround: Read the in-product brief and source coverage.
items.closure: A configured authorised destination and delivery evidence; additional origin-restricted source adapters.

items.capability: Additional runtime, API and subjective benchmark execution
items.why: Only qualified existing adapters can execute; generic provisioners and judge adapters are incomplete.
items.userImpact: Some providers/runtimes/validators remain unsupported despite view and schema support.
items.workaround: Use the supported local deterministic validator path.
items.closure: Capability-specific adapters with bounded authority, verified artifacts, cancellation and result provenance tests.
